rows.subtype: Approach: forms a hypothesis, sets a measure and runs a small test [Thinking]
rows.description: A student running a campus club guesses that posters outperform WhatsApp for turnout, sends each in different weeks, and counts how many attend.

rows.subtype: Approach: draws firm conclusions from too few results [Pitfall]
rows.description: A student tries a new study method for two days, sees a small improvement, and declares it works. Two data points cannot separate the method from luck.

rows.subtype: Approach: runs a pilot with a small group before a full rollout [Action]
rows.description: A young manager tests a new shift schedule with one team for a month, tracking absences and handover errors, before applying it to the whole floor.

rows.subtype: Approach: extends the trial and adds a comparison group after doubting the result [Revision]

rows.subtype: Approach: draws a picture of the problem to think through it [Action]

rows.subtype: Approach: writes a list to free up working memory [Action]

rows.subtype: Approach: sketches a mind map to see how parts connect [Thinking]

rows.subtype: Approach: keeps writing notes without acting on them [Pitfall]

rows.subtype: Approach: reviews the page and circles one next action [Revision]
